item.title: Making Of: Ten Million Chess Openings
item.description: Whenever I share something I made, I get a lot of emails and comments, and by far the most common question is: “how did you make this?” The honest answer is usually “slowly, and with a lot of fiddling”, but I figured it deserves a better answer than that. The common tools I use are d3, and custom code. Most are disheartened when they hear this; they want to hear there’s some magic software that can do it for them.
